feedback.end: Koalas are mammals that live in Australia. They are nocturnal, which means they are awake during the night. They love to sleep in the branches of eucalyptus trees - often for around 18 hours a day!
Koala’s have five fingers with sharp claws on each of their front paws. This gives them a strong grip when climbing and holding onto tree branches.
Koalas are herbivores, which means they only eat plants. Their favourite food is eucalyptus leaves, which are poisonous to humans and most other animals.
